hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that handles swap execution entirely in `beforeSwap` using `beforeSwapReturnsDelta`. It takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into Euler vaults, withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and verifies trades against a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), bypassing Uniswap v4's concentrated liquidity entirely.
